description: The line plot illustrates the BLEU score as a function of training epochs for three distinct data subsets: “Regular members,” “Members with near-duplicates,” and “Held-out data.” The x-axis, labeled “Epochs,” spans from 0 to 3.0 with tick marks at intervals of 0.5, using a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU score,” ranges from 0.00 to 0.35, also on a linear scale, with major gridlines and tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The “Regular members” line (dark blue, solid) begins near 0.02 at epoch 0, rises gradually to approximately 0.06 by epoch 1.0, and then plateaus with minor fluctuations around 0.06–0.07 through epoch 3.0. The “Members with near-duplicates” line (orange, solid) starts near 0.02, increases sharply to about 0.10 by epoch 0.5, continues rising steeply to 0.25 by epoch 1.5, and then climbs more gradually to peak near 0.36 at epoch 2.5 before leveling off slightly at epoch 3.0. The “Held-out data” line (dark green, solid) begins near 0.02, rises slightly to about 0.04 by epoch 0.5, then remains relatively flat with small oscillations between 0.03 and 0.05 through epoch 3.0. All three lines are plotted without markers, using solid lines of distinct colors, and are identified in a legend positioned in the upper center of the plot.
